groupings.title: Brief to finished video
groupings.description: Hand over a brief and get a smooth, phone-legible vector animation delivered for LinkedIn, PowerPoint or any size, with a gate after every step.

groupings.title: Story to storyboard
groupings.description: Turn a brief into beats that a muted phone feed can actually read, with the timing math done for you.

groupings.title: Assets and scenes
groupings.description: Source icons and illustrations you are actually allowed to ship, then lay them out so they stay legible on a phone.

groupings.title: Motion that stays smooth
groupings.description: Choreograph entrances, holds, transitions and seamless loops from the frame, with a linter that catches the flicker before you render.

groupings.title: Deliver anywhere
groupings.description: Render to LinkedIn, PowerPoint, GIF or any resolution with presets traced to the platforms' own specs, and prove each file before you send it.
